    MIN(humepct) as min_humidity, MAX(humepct) as max_humidity,

WITH site_env AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry,
        s.zonelabel,
        s.digunit,
        s.gridtrace,
        s.geox,
        s.geoy,
        s.heightm,
        s.depthc,
        s.phasefactor,
        s.typesite,
        s.presstat,
        AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_temperature,
        AVG(se.humepct) as avg_humidity,
        AVG(se.illumelux) as avg_illumination,
        -- Compute ESI: normalize each factor and combine
        -- Temperature score: penalize extremes, reward moderate temps (optimal ~20C)
        -- Humidity score: penalize extremes, reward moderate humidity (optimal ~50%)
        -- Illumination score: higher is better
        (1 - ABS(AVG(se.ambictemp) - 20) / 50.0) * 
        (1 - ABS(AVG(se.humepct) - 50) / 50.0) * 
        (AVG(se.illumelux) / 99850.0) as esi
    FROM sites s
    LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, s.digunit, s.gridtrace, s.geox, s.geoy, s.heightm, s.depthc, s.phasefactor, s.typesite, s.presstat
)
